messages.text: The Eureka 16" Blue Ocean is a desktop globe — it sits on a desk, bookshelf, or credenza with its black metal gyromatic base, not a floor piece. At 16", it's a nice step up from the 12" Student Desktop you also looked at, giving you a larger, more detailed map to read while still being a desk-sized piece. Are you choosing between those two for a specific desk or space?

The Eureka 16" Blue Ocean Raised Relief Globe is a great fit then — it's one of our largest true desktop sizes, with a full gyromatic metal base so it tilts and spins freely, and the raised relief lets you feel mountain ranges as you trace them. You'll find it under that exact name in the search bar, ready to add to your cart.
You're welcome! Enjoy the Eureka — feel free to come back if you have any other questions.
